proposed_connector.name: argentina_afip.query_employer_registry
proposed_connector.description: Argentina AFIP (Administracion Federal de Ingresos Publicos) employer / CUIT registry. Public lookup confirming a CUIT-registered Argentine legal entity exists with the given name and is active.
proposed_connector.rationale: Cross-border project vendors named in foreign-private-issuer filings are typically not in any US registry; AFIP / IGJ is the authoritative public registry for Argentine corporate existence and tax-active status, the analog of EDGAR-existence for a vendor counterparty.
proposed_connector.completeness: all Argentine tax-registered legal entities (broad coverage)

claims.extraction_notes: No catalog connector covers Argentine corporate-existence checks. Magna Construcciones SRL is named as a Cauchari-Olaroz contractor; an AFIP CUIT lookup is the registry-side existence check. Without this connector the claim is structurally UNVERIFIABLE via US registries (a tiny Argentine SRL will not appear on EDGAR).
